Exceeded any expectations!!
Nov 2024 • Friends
Beautiful beautiful cozy cafe and restaurant. We are Canadians who have been a bit disappointed with the food safety standards we’ve found so far in Vietnam, so we found this place on trip advisor, accompanied by many many fantastic reviews and this place absolutely exceeded our expectations. A cozy place, filled with greenery, a visible effort to be as eco conscious and locally sourced as you possible. The food menu (for dinner / lunch) was not huge. But we were able to find a few things we wanted and each thing is better than the last!!! Definitely come here you will not leave disappointed!
